Fantastic value of money, La Storia Hotel is located right in a really Tranquil street – one of a very rare streets in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter nowadays. But it will take only few minute walking to reach Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, Hanoi Opera House and the popular Thang Long Water Puppet Show. Indeed, be contiguous to attractive moves such as Night Market on Hang Ngang, Hang Dao Str (every Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights), Ancient House of Hanoi in Ma May street, shopping centers and banking facilities. A cozy and homely stay at La Storia Hotel it is a good choice for couple, twin and families travelers in Hanoi.
